cases.explain: The preposition из (from) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он был учителем, сведущим в ___ Моисея.
cases.translation: He was a skilled teacher in the law of Moses.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing the object of knowledge requires the prepositional case; в чем? (in what?) requires prepositional.

cases.sentence: Царь дал ему все, о чем он просил, потому что на нем была рука ___ его Бога.
cases.translation: The king granted him all he asked for, because the hand of the Lord his God was upon him.
cases.explain: The genitive case marks possession; рука кого? (hand of whom?) requires genitive.

cases.sentence: Некоторые пришли в ___ в 7 году правления царя.
cases.translation: Some came to Jerusalem in the seventh year of the king's reign.
cases.explain: The preposition в (to) indicating motion toward requires the accusative case; в + accusative for destinations.

cases.sentence: Он отправился в путь из Вавилона в первый день первого месяца и прибыл в ___ в пятый день пятого месяца.
cases.translation: He started out from Babylon on the first day of the first month and arrived at Jerusalem on the fifth day of the fifth month.
cases.explain: The preposition в (to) with motion requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ездра посвятил себя изучению и исполнению ___ закона.
cases.translation: Ezra had set his heart to seek the Lord's law, to do it, and to teach the statutes and ordinances of Israel.
cases.explain: The genitive case marks possession; закон кого? (law of whom?) requires genitive.
The preposition от (from) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ты посылаешься ___ и семью его советниками.
cases.translation: You are sent by the king and his seven counselors.
cases.explain: The instrumental case marks the agent of an action after the passive verb; посылаешься кем? (are sent by whom?) requires instrumental.

reading.ru: После этих событий, в правление царя Персии Артаксеркса, Ездра, сын Сераи, пришел из Вавилона.
reading.question: Who came from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes?
reading.explain: Ездра, сын Сераи пришел из Вавилона — Ezra, son of Seraiah came from Babylon.

reading.ru: Он был учителем, сведущим в законе Моисея, который дал Господь Бог Израиле.
reading.question: What was Ezra's expertise?
options: He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses given by the Lord
He was a priest and judge
He was a builder and architect
reading.correct: He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses given by the Lord
reading.explain: Он был учителем сведущим в законе Моисея — He was a skilled teacher in the law of Moses.

reading.ru: Царь дал ему все, о чем он просил, потому что на нем была рука Господа его Бога.
reading.question: Why did the king grant Ezra all his requests?
options: Because the hand of the Lord his God was upon him
Because he was related to the king
Because he was a wealthy man
reading.correct: Because the hand of the Lord his God was upon him
reading.explain: рука Господа его Бога была на нем — the hand of the Lord his God was upon him.

reading.ru: Я повелеваю, всякий из израилетян в Моем Царстве, включая священников и левитов, кто желает идти в Иерусалим вместе с тобой, может идти.
reading.question: What did the king decree about Israelites, priests, and Levites?
options: That any of them who wished could go to Jerusalem with Ezra
That they must all return to Babylon
That they were forbidden to go
That only priests could make the journey
reading.correct: That any of them who wished could go to Jerusalem with Ezra
reading.explain: всякий из израилетян кто желает идти в Иерусалим может идти — any who wished could go to Jerusalem.

reading.ru: Немедленно купи на эти деньги быков, баранов и ягнят, вместе с их хлебными приношениями и жертвенными возлияниями, и принеси их на жертвенник дома вашего Бога в Иерусалиме.
reading.question: What was Ezra commanded to buy and offer on the altar?
options: Bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and drink offerings
reading.correct: Bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and drink offerings
reading.explain: купи быков баранов и ягнят и принеси их на жертвенник — buy bulls, rams, and lambs and offer them on the altar.

reading.ru: Так как рука Господа моего Бога была на мне, я отважился и собрал вождей из Израиля, чтобы им идти со мной.
reading.question: What did Ezra do because the hand of his God was upon him?
options: He gathered together chief men of Israel to go up with him
He refused to go to Jerusalem
He appointed priests to rule in Jerusalem
reading.correct: He gathered together chief men of Israel to go up with him
reading.explain: я собрал вождей из Израиля чтобы им идти со мной — I gathered chief men of Israel to go up with me.
